The '''Serenity system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tashtor sector/Legends|Tashtor sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenity (planet)|Serenity]] was located in the system.
